# OpenAI Whisper model attribution

The bundled `ggml-base-q5_1.bin` contains a quantized conversion of the
multilingual Whisper Base model released by OpenAI under the MIT license.

- Source project: https://github.com/openai/whisper
- Converted model distribution: https://huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp
- Bundled converted artifact: `ggml-base-q5_1.bin`
